text:
Both assistants correctly categorize the four questions (Literature, History, Science, Art). However, the user explicitly instructed to "refrain from uttering any extraneous words" and to "list only one topic per sentence." Assistant A includes numerals ("1.", "2.", etc.) which are extraneous elements not part of the topic itself, and the lines are list fragments rather than sentences. Assistant B provides exactly one topic per line, formatted as a complete one-word sentence (ending with a period), containing no extraneous words or numerals. Therefore, Assistant B adheres more strictly to the formatting constraints.

[[B]]
